decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component spraying system serves a specialized corrosion-protection niche central to WIWA's core coating business and is still listed on the website.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own dedicated page and a documented field application, which signals strong commitment and market traction.
The low-pressure transfer pump reuses proven air motor technology, so it costs little to maintain and complements the established pump range.
Fire protection flow monitoring has a dedicated page and supports the firm's fire-protection coating equipment, adding value to core systems.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched only in 2024 and fits the core product line, so it is too early to withdraw it.
